title: Training Notes: Appraisal Rush Fees on a Mortgage Loan File Revised Loan Estimate
content:
**The rule.** For a revised Loan Estimate on a Mortgage Loan File, where the borrower requested rush turn time on the file's live primary appraisal order and a rush fee charge is booked on it, the booked rush fee is added; where the borrower requested rush turn time but no rush fee charge is booked, the report type's rush fee is added; where rush turn time was not requested, or the file has no live primary appraisal order, nothing is added.

The facts come from the file's live primary Appraisal Order — the order placed on the file as a standard order, a transferred-in order or a new order after expiration that is not cancelled; a file carries at most one such order: whether the borrower asked for rush turn time when the order was placed, the rush fee charges booked among its appraisal charges, and the rush fee set for the order's report type in the Appraisal Order report-type schedule.

## Questions answered

**The borrower asked for rush turn time and the rush fee was charged. What is added?** The booked rush fee, as charged on the Appraisal Order.

**The borrower asked for rush turn time but no rush fee charge is on the order. What is added?** The rush fee of the order's report type, from the report-type schedule.

**Rush turn time was never requested, but the order shows a rush fee charge. What is added?** Nothing; the line turns on the borrower's request.

| Rush requested on the Appraisal Order | Rush fee charge booked on it | Added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the booked rush fee |
| yes | no | the report type's rush fee |
| no | either | nothing |
| no live primary appraisal order on the file | — | nothing |
